messages:
kevin: Starting a blue/green traffic shift for router-edge v1.4 -> v1.5 in ap-south. Plan: 5% -> 25% -> 60% with 3m observation windows. Cookie pin rw_edge=1h.
anita: Copy. I'll run the smoke suite and tail error budgets.
deploy-bot: routing update applied -> v1.5=5% (change-id cfg-9443).
sam: Initial smoke: OK for small seqs, one 504 on streaming path at +2m. P95 up ~8ms.
infra-bot: Node alert: ap-south-c host gpu pressure flagged (swap 1.2GB).
kevin: Hold next step. Do not advance to 25%. Anita, keep probes running.
anita: Pausing. Captured failing request and logs; looks like nginx upstream timeout on one pod. Marking pod id router-v1-5-3 for investigation.
deploy-bot: routing update requested -> HOLD.
sam: I can repro 504 by hitting longer streams from that pod. Raising to infra to investigate memory.
infra-bot: Scheduling node drain for ap-south-c and rebalancing.
kevin: Rollback to v1.4 weights=100% while infra stabilizes. Command: ops-api route update -> v1.5=0%
deploy-bot: routing update applied -> v1.5=0%, v1.4=100% (rollback complete).
anita: Adding note to release issue INF-1907 and attaching logs. Will reattempt small canary after node fix and nginx keepalive tweak.
kevin: Closing window early. Thanks team.
